thread:
rachael: quick sync — customer X pushed for air-gapped install in Q3. want to align on MVP scope: do we prioritize VPC control plane first or full airgap packaging?

sam: i'd lean control plane first. smaller surface, unblock most customers who need private control plane + VPC.

mitesh: +1 on control plane. airgap has a bunch of unknowns (cert signing, KMS in offline env, incubation). can we do 'control plane w/ airgap-compatible packaging' as interim?

owen: define "airgap-compatible" — do you mean tarball + offline deps, or fully certified airgapped installer? big diff for QE and legal.

rachael: good point. proposal: 1) MVP: VPC control plane (customer-managed infra) + onprem runtime tarball (basic offline bundle) 2) Phase 2: certified airgap installer (signed packages, HSM/KMS patterns, offline upgrade path).

lina: from support perspective we need acceptance criteria for the tarball option: install idempotent, logs to local files, upgrade path documented, smoke test passes. also need clear SLAs we can promise.

sam: suggested acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- unattended install script (bash)
- bundle contains sha256 sums for artifacts
- offline dependency list + vendored python wheels
- smoke test: start control-plane, register node, basic inference call -> 200
- rollback path defined
- telemetry toggle off by default
```

mitesh: add security requirements: default disable telemetry, KMS integration examples for AWS KMS and customer HSM, documented key rotation. legal needs export-control checklist for binary signing.

rachael: can we map these to engineering estimates? @sam, rough sizing for packaging + docs + QE?

sam: rough -> packaging + build infra: 3 eng-weeks, docs + install guide: 1 eng-week, QE automation: 2 eng-weeks. airgap certified installer (phase 2): additional 6-8 eng-weeks. these are parallelizable to some extent.

owen: dependencies: eng-infra for signed-binaries pipeline, eng-security for KMS spec, qa for offline test harness. blocking items: signing pipeline + legal sign-off.

deploy-bot: scheduled meeting added: #private-deploy-prio on Thu 09:30 PT (link: https://meet/rdw/priv-deploy).

lina: customer asks a guarantee on "no outbound connections by default" for airgap. for MVP tarball we should make that explicit in docs and have smoke test run in fully offline environment.

rachael: agreed. action items: @sam open RFC with packaging plan + CI changes; @mitesh draft security/KMS pattern doc; @owen coordinate QE offline harness; @lina draft acceptance criteria and support runbook. target: decision by next Thu meeting to lock MVP for Q3 planning.

sam: I'll put a short RFC up today with the install script prototype snippet.

mitesh: pinging legal on binary signing and export control now.

rachael: thanks. if no major objections we'll slot control plane MVP (tarball + offline checklist) into Q3-OKR as "Private: Control Plane MVP (VPC + offline bundle)" and scope airgap certified in Q4. please flag if that blocks customer commitments. :thumbsup:

owen: :thumbsup: — QE will need early test image by EOW to start automation.

sam: copy, will share artifacts link when RFC is up.

lina: noted, will draft runbook template this afternoon.

rachael: great. end of thread.
